verdict.rationale: Rive ships a built-in AI agent, so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question. However, the MCP evidence only describes the reverse direction: the Rive Editor exposes its own tools (View Models, State Machines, Layouts) to outside AI tools, which makes Rive an MCP server. Nothing in the pack shows Rive's agent connecting to third-party MCP servers or using their tools.
